text:
anya: Heads-up 1: pilot customers want a compact observability bundle for console: 2 dashboards (latency + cost), 1 tracing hook example, CSV export.

tom: Propose minimal scope: feature flag, importable dashboard JSON, JS/Python trace snippet, lightweight cost API.

rashid: Runtime notes: span attrs -> metrics bridge needed. Sampling: 100% errors, 3% successes, keep 500 prefixes in head cache. Retention for labs: 7d raw, 30d pre-agg.

sam: Acceptance criteria suggestion:
- dashboard load p95 < 750ms on synthetic data
- trace hook overhead < 1ms median
- CSV export < 4s for 24h slice
- billing parity within 3%

tom: Risks: dashboard queries could hammer metrics. Mitigation: pre-aggregate + cap refresh rate for labs tenants.

anya: Rollout path: labs flag -> internal QA -> Acme canary -> Orchid canary -> GA. Timeline: 5w labs build, 2w canary, 2w polish.

infra-bot: deploy-scheduler: queued deploy for branch feature/obs-mini at 1767980200; est window 30m.

anya: Next steps: tom + rashid draft dashboard JSON + trace snippet by Fri; sam to write benchmark script. Keep feature behind labs flag until post-canary signoff.
